entries.speaker: Metaverse Navigator
entries.en: A new area has been confirmed in the[n]depths. Updating guidance information.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What's this?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It sounds like we can go further down[n]now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's because we made Madarame's Palace[n]disappear, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Most likely... I think.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You seem rather uncertain.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How far does this... Mementos run,[n]anyway?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Uhhh...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's huge...! Extremely.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're always so vague when it comes to[n]the important stuff.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's like he's kinda flaky as our chief[n]of operations. Don't you want him to[n]try a bit harder too?
Totally.
He's doing his best.
The cat does good.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You've got some nerve, you two!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You truly are different from that moron[n]over there!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You didn't have to add that cat part!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There, there...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't fully understand, but Mementos[n]and the Palaces are related to each other,[n]correct?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Then all we must do is continue changing[n]the hearts of evildoers to ascertain its[n]full expanse.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't believe there's a need to quarrel[n]over it.
